assign.outcome:
**Toolbar placement lands as a fifth axis on the shared `Paging.Toolbar`, plus a takeover exit chip.** `toolbar` joins `style`/`content`/`layout`/`mech` — eight words (`top-inside` … `bottom-outside`), same `pick(axis, value)` seam, default `top-outside` (the exact shape every existing page already had, so nothing moved). `inside` nests the toolbar as `.paging-box`'s own flex child (on `card` that's literally inside the white padded shadowed frame); `outside` keeps it a stage-level sibling. A `full` page (declared, takeover-forced, or chip-picked) now grows a `close_fullscreen` chip linking to its parent url — the second way out beside the crumb strip and the head's ×.

[Toolbars](/imagine/paging/toolbars/) — all eight placements × five surfaces live on one page, no navigation. [Top](/imagine/paging/toolbars/top/) · [Left](/imagine/paging/toolbars/left/) · [Right](/imagine/paging/toolbars/right/) · [Bottom](/imagine/paging/toolbars/bottom/) — the four stops worth a url, each landing `inside` a card and still switchable. [`doc/decisions.md`](/imagine/paging/doc/decisions.md) has the wave-2 record.

**Proved** (ui-test, 1280/3440, `shots/`): all four `-inside` values report the toolbar rect fully contained in `.paging-box`'s rect; all four `-outside` values report not-contained. Exit chip: hub → walk's Takeover → 1 visible column → click `.paging-exit` → 3 columns back (rail + hub + Mechanisms), zero console errors, both widths. At 400: nothing overflows (0px), but left/right claim ~38% of the viewport for the chip stack — usable, tightest four, no CSS fallback to `top` shipped (a future breakpoint, owner's call).

**Re-ran core's own checks**: zero console errors at 400/1280/1920/3440 on the hub, mechanisms/, styles/, sizes/, center/, and the new toolbars/ tree — 40 checks, all clean. No existing chip moved.

**Left open**: `toolbars/` is not yet in the hub's `children:` (the mastermind's job, per the brief's fence) — reachable today only by direct url. `readme.md` untouched (outside the fence). No CSS breakpoint auto-falls back left/right to `top` at narrow widths — measured and reported, not enforced. `ext/layout`'s own toolbar+drawer (framework/ext/layout) is a dev/editing bar with a push-drawer and a `words` control registry — it offers per-region floating controls and page-word knobs, nothing about placement of a mode toolbar on a content page; not reused, not overlapping.
